text: sync: a pushed list row for a list you are not on is an unquarantinable 403 that rolls back the batch

Landed. The list path now answers the row-scoped 422 unknown_list with row_id that the item path already used, so a device that still shows a list the account has left parks that row instead of retrying forever. Verified on the fixed build: the push returns 422 with row_id. Note the agent checked and no client change is needed — unknown_list is already in both error tables and Android parks on any 422 carrying row_id.
